    • Constructor Detail

      • DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider

        public DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider(String password)
        Constructs a credentials provider for simple login with password only. This is being checked against abas ERP password database.
        Parameters:
        password - abas ERP password for login

      • DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider

        public DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider(String userName,
                                     String password)
        Constructs a credentials provider for login with username and password. Credentials a being checked against authentication backend configured at ERP server. This can be unix operating system as well as an LDAP or ActiveDirectory server via PAM.
        Parameters:
        userName - user name for login
        password - password for login

      • DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider

        public DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider(String userName,
                                     String password,
                                     boolean webLogin)
        Constructs a credentials provider for login as web user with username and password if webLogin is true. If webLogin is false, the method does the same as DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider(String, String).
        Parameters:
        userName - user name for login
        password - user's password for login
        webLogin - whether credentials shall be checked against abas ERP web user database.
        See Also:
        DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider(String, String)

      • DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider

        public DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider(String userName,
                                     String password,
                                     boolean webLogin,
                                     boolean forceLicence)
        Constructs a credentials provider for login as web user with username and password if webLogin is true. If webLogin is false, the method does the same as DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider(String, String). Additionally, occopation of a separate licences can be requested.
        Parameters:
        userName - user name for login
        password - user's password for login
        webLogin - whether credentials shall be checked against abas ERP web user database.
        forceLicence - Whether a separate licence shall be occupied.

      • DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider

        public DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider(String userName,
                                     String password,
                                     boolean webLogin,
                                     String webApplication)
        Constructs a credentials provider for login as web user for a certain web application with username and password if webLogin is true. If webLogin is false, the method does the same as DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider(String, String).
        Parameters:
        userName - user name for login
        password - user's password for login
        webLogin - whether credentials shall be checked against abas ERP web user database.
        webApplication - The web application name.

      • DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider

        public DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider(String userName,
                                     String password,
                                     boolean webLogin,
                                     String webApplication,
                                     boolean forceLicence)
        Constructs a credentials provider for login as web user for a certain web application with username and password if webLogin is true. If webLogin is false, the method does the same as DefaultEDPCredentialsProvider(String, String). Additionally, occupation of a separate licences can be requested.
        Parameters:
        userName - user name for login
        password - user's password for login
        webLogin - whether credentials shall be checked against abas ERP web user database.
        webApplication - The web application name.
        forceLicence - Whether a separate licence shall be occupied.

      • useWebLogin

        public boolean useWebLogin()
        Provides the information, whether log in shall be processed as web login. In this case user name and password are checked against web user configuration. Liefert True, falls die Anmeldung als Web-Benutzer erfolgen soll.
        Specified by:
        useWebLogin in interface EDPCredentialsProvider
        Returns:
        true if log in shall be processed as web login
        See Also:
        EDPCredentialsProvider.getWebApplication()

      • getWebApplication

        public String getWebApplication()
        Provides the web application for which the login shall be processed. This is only meaningful if EDPCredentialsProvider.useWebLogin() == true.
        Specified by:
        getWebApplication in interface EDPCredentialsProvider
        Returns:
        The web application name.
        See Also:
